summary: Full test of Fifthback Pattern Room feature. Backend pytest (test_pattern_room.py): 8 passed, 1 skipped. Signals endpoint returns 24 Turkish signals including the two anchor phrases. GET /api/pattern-room/analysis returns valid PatternRoomAnalysis with 5 clusters (each with signal_indices in 0..23) and 5 top patterns with all required fields; rank=1 is decision-flow/ownership bottleneck ('Karar Akışı / Sahiplik Darboğazı') combining 9 signals. No currency/money figures in any estimated_cost (qualitative language). POST /api/pattern-room/analyze SKIPPED because a direct localhost curl to the endpoint did not return within 180s (no wall-clock guard) and via preview URL it returns Cloudflare 502 after 100s; the cached analysis in Mongo IS 'live' (produced during main-agent seeding) so live-path has worked, but real-time /analyze from user requests will time out at the ingress. Regression tests /api/patterns, /api/interpret, /api/distinction, /api/evaluate all pass. Frontend playwright: nav-patternroom-tab renders pattern-room view; 24 pr-signal-* chips, pr-cluster-c1..c5, pr-top-pattern-1..5 all visible; pr-open-1 opens pr-detail-dialog with 4 tabs (pr-tab-cam, pr-tab-impact, pr-tab-past, pr-tab-next); FF CAM shows supporting signal quotes, inference and uncertainty; Hamle shows 3 next moves. Clicking pr-cluster-c1 opens the matching pattern dialog. Two minor React warnings only (missing DialogDescription aria).

minor.issue: No wall-clock timeout/fallback: direct localhost curl did not return in 180s; via preview URL it returns Cloudflare 502 after ~100s. Function should wrap the LLM call in asyncio.wait_for(...) with e.g. 60-70s and fall back to curated on TimeoutError (already handles Exception -> curated, just needs a timeout wrapper).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby (console a11y warning) — add a <DialogDescription> in the header.

action_items: Wrap analyze_pattern_room_llm's chat.send_message in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=60) and fall back to _curated_pattern_room() on TimeoutError so POST /api/pattern-room/analyze cannot exceed the Cloudflare 100s ceiling.
Add <DialogDescription> to PatternRoom detail Dialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 919 lines with 4 LLM workers (interpret, distinction, evaluate, pattern-room) all reproducing the same LlmChat + regex-JSON-extract + broad try/except scaffolding. Extract _call_claude_json(system, prompt, session_prefix) helper and split pattern-room (models + curated seed + prompt + LLM parser + routes ≈ 280 lines) into backend/pattern_room.py — the previous iteration already flagged this pattern.

analyze_pattern_room_llm has NO wall-clock timeout. On Cloudflare ingress the outer request will 502 at ~100s but the FastAPI task keeps running and holds a worker slot. Use asyncio.wait_for or the LLM SDK's timeout option.

GET /api/pattern-room/analysis returns cached document without validating that its schema is still current (e.g. after a code change to PRTopPattern). If a field is added, cached row will fail response_model validation — consider stamping a schema_version on the cache and invalidating on mismatch.

PatternRoom.js reads `p.confidence.split('—')[0]` without guarding for missing/em-dash-less strings; LLM output that returns confidence without an em-dash will still render fine but will show the whole string in the small badge. Minor.

signal_indices are trusted from Mongo without a runtime bounds check when re-emitting; if cache is ever tampered, indices >23 could crash the UI (`data.signals[si]` -> undefined). Curated code guarantees this, but the /analyze parser filters, and cache trusts blindly.

No rate-limit on POST /api/pattern-room/analyze — a single click is one full 60-90s Claude call; a burst of clicks will pin the backend. Add a cooldown or in-flight lock keyed on 'pattern-room-analyze'.

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9 passed, 1 skipped due to legit fallback / no-timeout bug)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing pattern_room_cache in Mongo already contains a 'live'-source analysis produced during main-agent seeding; curated fallback verified via _curated_pattern_room() schema validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pattern Room endpoints and UI all match the contract. Only outstanding backend risk is the missing wall-clock timeout on POST /api/pattern-room/analyze — reproduce with `curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/pattern-room/analyze --max-time 200` (times out). Current cache in Mongo has source='live' (from prior successful run), so the GET path continues to serve full live analysis. All 24 signals, 5 clusters (c1..c5), and 5 patterns are rendered correctly. Data-testids confirmed: nav-patternroom-tab, pattern-room, pr-signal-0..23, pr-cluster-c1..c5, pr-top-pattern-1..5, pr-open-1..5, pr-detail-dialog, pr-tab-cam/impact/past/next, pr-next-move-0..2, pr-source, pr-reanalyze-btn. Regression endpoints /interpret /distinction /evaluate /patterns still green.
rca of the issue: POST /api/pattern-room/analyze occasionally hangs > 100s -> Cloudflare 502. Root cause: analyze_pattern_room_llm awaits chat.send_message with no timeout; when Claude is slow (large 24-signal prompt with 3-role instructions), the request exceeds the Cloudflare edge ceiling. Fix: `try: resp = await asyncio.wait_for(chat.send_message(...), timeout=60); except asyncio.TimeoutError: return _curated_pattern_room()` inside analyze_pattern_room_llm.
